mechanism.inference: Control/verification/renewal and parent-directory RPC work consumed the shared staging wall clock. The roughly 120-second gaps dominate, not file size or sustained upload bandwidth. Mapping each unlabelled exec call to an exact operation is inferred from code order, not recorded RPC payload evidence.

mechanism.structural_risk: The shared clock continues through renewals, directory RPCs and verification; some RPC recovery can continue under its own bound after the shared staging deadline. A later PUT is where the exhausted cap surfaces. Increasing the job timeout would not extend the fixed 300-second staging ceiling.
